tests.method: node --import tsx --test tests/learning*.test.ts against vp_mod_learning, 2 consecutive green runs; tsc clean

works: Propose: evidence = open issues, moments (by hazard), recent live calls with judge results, and the workspace's lessons; the LLM (purpose 'learning', JSON) returns ops on the latest version's config; every cited id is checked against this workspace's own rows; uncited proposals are gated out

Gates (block, never warn): editable allowlist, empty locked-section diff on the resolved config, provenance (no new number or unverified domain), manipulation lint (incl. Hinglish urgency), never-say, shared lintAgentConfig and replyDoor
Tenant library: a change this workspace already rejected, lost or stopped (same change hash) is not re-proposed

Probe: test.simulate_batch on current and proposed configs with the same sim callers and seeds; fewer passes or any guarded metric worse (safety_violations, disclosure_missed, hung_up, cut_ins, reply_gap_ms) rejects and records a lesson; unreported metrics are listed, not assumed fine

Accept (A2): treatment version made by the agents module's version.candidate (learning never writes agent_version); if that tool is missing the experiment is still pre-registered and experiment.start retries, then refuses with a plain reason. Baseline from the workspace's own live calls on the control version (or given), Fleiss power at alpha 0.05 / power 0.8, calls-to-prove stored before launch, pre-registration hash, binding (campaign|inbound|web, default campaign)
Start (A2): shadow A/A (1,000 re-randomisations of the tenant's own contacts) plus outcome-plumbing check; too little history waits (aa_pending), broken plumbing fails (aa_failed + issue)
Assign: sticky arm per contact (hash of experiment and contact); stopped/decided experiments send no traffic

Check: test calls excluded; any treatment safety violation, 3+ complaints/opt-outs at 2x control, or the always-valid mSPRT harm test stops the arm at once, calls deployment.revert_to_last_good {agentId, binding} (A3), opens a critical issue and records a lesson

No peeking: effect is neither computed nor shown before the horizon and the minimum days; at the horizon one two-sided two-proportion z test; a win is proposed as deployment.split at 100% treatment on the experiment's binding, only if that tool is approval-gated, so it becomes an A2 card
No pooling: every query filters by workspace; rows in another workspace that point at this workspace's versions are ignored (tested)

Calls contract: success values are the business's outcome_definition.goal_values (via the campaign that runs the agent, else the goal's outcome key, or outcomeDefinitionId); hazard codes default to catalogue END_OPTED_OUT / CONV_COMPLAINT / END_CRISIS; baseline, power, horizon, verdict and the shadow A/A count only contacts with a recorded outcome (NULL = untrusted AI guess), and the card says so; guardrails count every live contact. Cross-module test writes conversations the way calls does
untested: Against real sibling modules (all four sibling tools are fakes in tests)
With a real LLM: proposal quality, cost per cycle, and the INR 200/day test budget are not metered here
Moment-level fast lane on live calls (moment rows are read as evidence; this module does not compute hazards)
Clustered standard errors: the unit is the contact, but repeat calls within a contact are collapsed rather than modelled
Winner expiry/drift (60 days) and re-confirm cards; staged safety ramp (first 50 calls at 20%); Bonferroni for more than two arms
Retry/pacing policy changes: they live in campaigns, outside the agent config this module edits
Guardrails other than safety violations and complaint/opt-out reason codes (cut-ins, reply gap, disclosure rate, CLI flags)
needs_from_others: agents: test.simulate_batch {agentId, config, simCallerIds, seeds} -> {runs:[{simCallerId, seed, passed, metrics:{hung_up, safety_violations, disclosure_missed, cut_ins, reply_gap_ms}}]} (risk test) — not registered yet at e411b38
agents: version.candidate {agentId, config, parentVersionId, note} -> {versionId, number, versionHash, brief} — not registered yet; until then experiments cannot start

agents or calls: deployment.revert_to_last_good {agentId, binding} (A3 verb) — not registered yet; until then a hazard stop still cuts treatment traffic via experiment.assign and opens a critical issue
calls/campaigns: call experiment.assign {agentId, contactId} at dial time, stamp conversation.agent_version_id with the version that ran, and call experiment.check after each connected call
calls: keep conversation.outcome NULL unless verified, a person's label or a trusted judge's guess (refreshOutcome), and reason_code from the catalogue enum

jobs.name: learning.check
jobs.does: experiment.check on every running experiment, each in its own workspace (guardrails, expiry, horizon)
